newsitem.title: UK: Euro low sulphur straight run tracks crude.
newsitem.headline: Euro low sulphur straight run tracks crude.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run was notionally firmer with crude, but a lack of physical product limited trade. Dealers said those with cargoes would be unwilling to let them go for less than $150 delivered.
High sulphur straight run was still overhanging the market, although there were some signs that supplies are less plentiful.

Shipping brokers said rates have dipped on slower business. An end-user bought a M-100 at $106-107 cif NWE, the price reflecting the high water content. The recent spate of straight run deals was set to ease, traders said.
